title: Pacing Branch Parallelism in LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2605.06914v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent methods expose intra-request parallelism in LLM outputs, allowing independent branches to decode concurrently. Existing serving systems execute these branches eagerly or under fixed caps. We show that both are brittle: eager admission inflates the shared decode step, degrading co-batched requests in serial stages, while conservative fixed caps forgo the throughput that motivated exposing branches in the first place. We call the excess step latency caused by admitted branches the \emph{branch externality} and show that the safe width depends on batch composition, context lengths, and accumulated slack, all of which change continuously over a workload trace. We introduce PACE, a per-step admission controller that treats extra branches as opportunistic width, admitted only when the predicted branch externality fits within the batch's current slack budget. translated_title: LLM 服务中的分支并行节奏调控
translated_abstract: 近期的方法在 LLM 输出中暴露了请求内并行性，使独立分支能够并发解码。现有的服务系统要么急切地执行这些分支，要么在固定上限下执行。我们证明这两种方式都很脆弱：急切接纳会膨胀共享的解码步长，从而降低串行阶段中共批处理请求的性能；而保守的固定上限则放弃了暴露分支本应带来的吞吐量。我们将被接纳分支所造成的额外步长延迟称为“分支外部性”，并表明安全宽度取决于批次组成、上下文长度和累积的松弛量，而这些因素在整个工作负载轨迹中都在持续变化。我们提出了 PACE，一个逐步接纳控制器，它将额外分支视为机会性的宽度，只有当预测的分支外部性能够容纳在批次当前的松弛预算之内时才予以接纳。逐步调控之所以切实可行，是因为分支级调度……
tldr: 提出了 PACE——一个逐步接纳控制器，通过预测“分支外部性”是否处于批次当前的松弛预算内来动态调控 LLM 服务中的分支并行宽度，从而在吞吐量与共批处理请求性能之间取得平衡。
